name: Hotel Pension Almrausch Danler
beschreibung: Hotel Pension Almrausch Danler is nestled in a quiet setting on the outskirts of Neustift im Stubaital. Proximity to the Elferbahnen lifts and the world-famous Stubai Glacier makes it an exceptional base for outdoor sports. The guest house blends traditional alpine woodwork with a warm family ambiance. Amenities include balcony rooms with panoramic mountain views, a fresh daily breakfast buffet, a restorative sauna area, and evening regional dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Pension Almrausch Danler in Neustift im Stubaital provides welcoming family lodging, a sauna wellness area, Tyrolean dining, and easy access to the Stubai Glacier.
